subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw support per-agent daily spend notifications as a permanent core configuration and persisted-state contract, rather than leaving spend awareness to existing pull-based usage views or an external integration?
rationale: The patch is a substantial new operator capability with durable state and documented configuration semantics; implementation proof cannot determine whether that long-term core product surface is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Accept the opt-in per-agent configuration and durable alert model, then require a rebase and final compatibility review against current main.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or pause the PR while retaining the linked request as the record for a future product decision.

options.title: Seek an extension boundary
options.body: Ask for a narrower plugin or external-accounting design only if maintainers identify a sufficient existing runtime seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in per-agent configuration and durable alert model, then require a rebase and final compatibility review against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete feature-history contact in the supplied review evidence; maintainer sponsorship itself still requires a repository decision-maker.
